top3.title: Aldi to open seven new UK stores in November
top3.why: Aldi plans seven openings between 12 and 26 November, starting with Basildon, as part of a £370m investment in its estate this year.
top3.nextStep: Approach Aldi UK's store development and marketing teams with a store-opening launch kit (exterior, wayfinding and opening-day POS), using our Asda and SPAR estate work as proof.

top3.title: Subway outlines UK plan with kiosks, grab-and-go fridges and a new store design
top3.why: Subway's UK blueprint includes self-order kiosks, a grab-and-go fridge and a more minimal store design as it tries to win back customers.
top3.nextStep: Send Subway UK's marketing and franchise development leads a short deck on menu-board and grab-and-go fixture POS for format rollouts, led by our Greggs work.

top3.title: VST to convert 35 stores to Loop Convenience under a five-year Co-op Wholesale deal
top3.why: VST is converting 35 South West and South Coast convenience stores under Co-op Wholesale's Proud to Stock Co-op proposition, starting with a refitted former Spar in Weymouth.
top3.nextStep: Contact Co-op Wholesale's retail development team (and VST directly) with our SPAR convenience fascia and POS case study before the remaining conversions are specced.

clients.headline: Asda Income Tracker shows lowest-income families face £76 weekly shortfall
clients.summary: Asda's latest Income Tracker shows growth in spending power slowed for a third straight month, with real spending power up 2.4% against household income growth of 3.8%. Asda says it has cut prices on 1,000 products and will hold them until after Christmas.
clients.why: Price-hold messaging into Christmas points to continued in-store price communication needs on the account.

clients.headline: Yorkshire Water reminds customers of Priority Services Register support
clients.summary: More than 352,000 customers, about 15% of the region's population, are on the register, which offers account help and bottled water during interruptions. Customers can sign up online or by phone.
clients.why: Awareness push for a support service, relevant to customer communications work.

clients.headline: Witchmark Distillery's vodka and gin listed in 39 Majestic Wine stores
clients.summary: Wiltshire's Witchmark Distillery has a Majestic Wine listing for its single-origin English vodka and Black Lime gin across 39 stores in the south-west, 29 of which already stock the products. The distillery calls it its largest retail deal to date.
clients.why: Shows Majestic listing local craft spirits, which suppliers may want to support in store.

clients.headline: Yorkshire Water to spend £3.6m replacing water mains in Wharncliffe Side and Brightholmlee
clients.summary: About 9km of clean water mains in Sheffield will be replaced by contract partner M Group to cut bursts and supply interruptions. It forms part of the £8.3bn investment programme, including £406m for over 1,000km of mains in 2025-2030.
clients.why: Ongoing works programme means continued customer and resident communications demand for the account.

clients.headline: Asda launches Asda Roots apprenticeship for 18 to 21-year-olds not in work or education
clients.summary: The scheme offers permanent paid jobs with a Level 2 qualification, starting with 16 young people across 8 stores. Asda plans to recruit 250 more in 2027.
clients.why: Store-level people programme that could feed internal comms and recruitment material for the account.

clients.headline: Asda among 32 organisations calling for mandatory UK supply chain due diligence law
clients.summary: Asda, Sainsbury's, Aldi and M&S are part of a group of 32 businesses, unions and campaign groups that has written to the government asking for a law requiring companies to check for human rights and environmental abuses in their operations and supply chains. The British Retail Consortium and the Ethical Trading Initiative are also backing the call.
clients.why: Gives context on Asda's public position on responsible sourcing, which could shape future sourcing messaging.

clients.headline: Compleat Food Group appoints first Chief Growth Officer and a Chief Product Officer
clients.summary: Steve Challouma, formerly CMO at Nomad Foods, joins as the group's first Chief Growth Officer, leading category-led growth and insights. Jo Smith, from Hilton Foods Group, joins as Chief Product Officer later this month.
clients.why: New growth and product leadership at the Real Yorkshire Pudding Co's parent group may reshape brand and marketing priorities. The article does not name the brand.

clients.headline: Northern-run Irlam station wins Rail Delivery Group's World Cup of Stations
clients.summary: Irlam station in Greater Manchester won the public vote with 4,786 votes, from more than 150 entries, beating Cardross, Brookwood, Yatton and Berney Arms in the final. Volunteers and a local charity restored the station, which now has a café bar, rooms for hire, a heritage room, gardens and a restored signal box.
clients.why: Northern is promoting stations as community spaces, a theme that could inform station-level communications.

prospects.headline: Co-op Wholesale signs five-year deal with VST covering 35 convenience stores
prospects.summary: Convenience operator VST is converting 35 stores across the South West and South Coast to Loop Convenience under Co-op Wholesale's Proud to Stock Co-op proposition. The first, in Weymouth, is a 2,000 sq ft former Spar site that has had a full internal refit and new branding.
prospects.why: A 35-store fascia conversion programme with refits is a concrete signage and in-store POS opportunity, via Co-op Wholesale or VST.

prospects.headline: Subway outlines UK plan with kiosks, grab-and-go fridge and minimalist store design
prospects.summary: Subway aims to double its EMEA footprint to 10,000 restaurants within five years, with hundreds of new UK sites planned. The blueprint includes more self-order kiosks, an evolved breakfast and coffee menu, a grab-and-go fridge to compete with Greggs, and a selective UK rollout of the 'Subway After Dark' dinner concept.
prospects.why: New store design, fridge and kiosk formats and a UK site rollout create a near-term need for in-store POS and menu communication.

prospects.headline: Aldi to open seven new UK stores in November as part of £370m estate investment
prospects.summary: Openings run from 12 to 26 November, including Basildon, Newport, Matlock, Stepney Green, Willesden, Orrell and Waterlooville. Aldi currently operates more than 1,090 stores and plans a record £900m investment in 2027.
prospects.why: Steady opening programme and a 2027 expansion plan mean recurring launch signage and store-opening activity.

prospects.headline: Morrisons launches Christmas sandwich range including three-course Festive Triple Sandwich
prospects.summary: The Christmas sandwich range is on sale from 19 October to 4 January, with the Festive Triple Sandwich arriving on 16 November. Morrisons will donate £50,000 from sales to Marie Curie.
prospects.why: Seasonal food-to-go range with a charity tie-in gives scope for in-store meal deal and festive POS support.

prospects.headline: Sainsbury's to top up NHS Healthy Start scheme with up to £18 per family
prospects.summary: Eligible families can receive £3 a week for six weeks as eGift cards from 18 November, with registration closing on 9 November. Sainsbury's says it is the first retailer to offer the top-up since the scheme moved to a prepaid card.
prospects.why: A time-limited scheme needing in-store awareness and sign-up messaging before 9 November.

prospects.headline: Primark names Emmett J. Scanlan as face of Christmas 2026 Primark Man campaign
prospects.summary: The 'Style Your Season' campaign launches on 3 November in stores and via Click & Collect, and was shot in Dublin.
prospects.why: Christmas campaign launching in stores in a week, with POS and window activity likely.

prospects.headline: Wickes reports Q3 revenue up 4.5% and plans 12 refits or refreshes this year
prospects.summary: Group revenue rose 4.5% to £439m, with two new stores opened in the quarter. The full-year plan is five new stores and 12 refits or refreshes across a 231-store network.
prospects.why: Ongoing refit programme is a possible store-environment opening.

prospects.headline: Shreddies launches peanut butter cereal with Dick and Dom pop-up in London
prospects.summary: Shreddies adds a Peanut Butter Flavour variant timed to October half-term, launched with a one-day pop-up café hosted by Dick and Dom on 27 October.
prospects.why: New product launch with an experiential push suggests supporting shopper marketing at retail.

prospects.headline: Fruit Shoot launches on-pack Christmas prize promotion with in-store point of sale
prospects.summary: Robinsons Fruit Shoot multipacks carry a 'Win Your Big Christmas Wish' promotion with a £5,000 top prize, running 5 October to 6 December. It is supported by in-store point of sale and digital out-of-home.
prospects.why: Brand already commissioning in-store POS for a seasonal promotion, so a relevant conversation on activation.

prospects.headline: West Yorkshire launches youth competition to shape serious violence campaign
prospects.summary: The Mayor and Violence Reduction Partnership are asking 11-25 year olds for ideas on staying safe from gangs and crime, open until 30 November. The winning idea will be developed into a countywide campaign with a professional company.
prospects.why: A named production partner is yet to be appointed for the countywide campaign, so there is a likely creative and delivery opening.

prospects.headline: Booker installs more than 500 advertising screens across 100 UK wholesale sites
prospects.summary: Tesco-owned Booker has fitted over 500 65-inch digital screens at rack ends and above pallets in 100 branches over eight weeks, creating a retail media network with dunnhumby and Pixel Inspiration. Brands can use it to reach independent retailers and hospitality businesses as they shop.
prospects.why: Tesco is building in-store media across its wholesale estate; suppliers advertising there may need supporting content and physical POS.

prospects.headline: M&S offers Sparks members up to £15 in festive rewards
prospects.summary: Until 1 January 2027, Sparks members who activate offers in the M&S app can earn up to £15 in total, for example £5 for spending £25 on Delacourt Champagne in England and Wales, or £20 on soft drinks and mixers in Scotland. Further £5 rewards cover flowers and M&S Café spend.
prospects.why: Festive loyalty offers across drink, flowers and café could need joined-up in-store promotion through Christmas.

prospects.headline: Costa launches 2026 Christmas menu in UK and Ireland from 22 October
prospects.summary: Costa's Christmas menu went on sale on 22 October across the UK and Ireland, with new drinks including a Golden Hazel Latte and Gingerbread Iced Matcha Latte, festive food and bakery, and gift merchandise. Gingerbread Latte sachets are returning to Tesco, Morrisons, Iceland and Sainsbury's.
prospects.why: A seasonal menu change across stores, Costa Express machines and grocery sachets spans several POS touchpoints.

prospects.headline: Quality Street launches Monopoly Christmas collaboration with on-pack prize promotion
prospects.summary: Nestlé's Quality Street tubs get Monopoly designs with Chance Cards, and shoppers can win 5,000 game boards or cash prizes up to £20,580. The promotion opens on 1 November 2026.
prospects.why: Large on-pack Christmas promotion that typically needs in-store display and promotional comms.

prospects.headline: Sheffield shortlisted for UK City of Culture 2029
prospects.summary: DCMS has selected Sheffield to progress, under the theme 'from Grassroots to Global'. Shortlisted places host an expert panel and present proposals, with the winner announced in early 2027; the winner receives £10 million.
prospects.why: A bid campaign through to early 2027 should need city-wide branding, signage and engagement materials.

prospects.headline: Morrisons launches Christmas pet range alongside 90 new pet products and new aisle signage
prospects.summary: The Christmas pet range starts at £1.50 and comes with 90 new products, the Boost and Thrive brands, and clearer in-aisle navigation and signage. More Card offers run from 26 October to 1 November.
prospects.why: Pet aisle relaunch with new signage and More Card promotions points to in-store communication needs.

prospects.headline: Sainsbury's reports first-half grocery sales up 2.9% and agrees Argos sale to Swift Partners
prospects.summary: Continuing underlying operating profit rose 3.6% to £525m for the 28 weeks to 12 September, and the Argos sale is expected to complete by end of February 2027. Sainsbury's expects to open around ten supermarkets and 25 convenience stores this year.
prospects.why: Store opening pipeline and Nectar personalisation push signal in-store and retail media comms demand.

prospects.headline: Nescafé brings back Gingerbread Flavour Latte with London pop-up in November
prospects.summary: The limited-edition latte returns after about ten years and will be sold in major retailers nationwide in November. A free pop-up styled as a gingerbread estate agent runs in London on 18 November.
prospects.why: Seasonal launch with retail availability and an experiential strand, so a likely need for in-store seasonal comms.

prospects.headline: Mr Kipling adds festive tarts, cake bites and smaller mince pie pack for Christmas 2026
prospects.summary: Mr Kipling is launching four seasonal products and a four-pack of Mince Pie Whirls at a lower entry price. Premier Foods cites a £307m Christmas cake category and lower penetration among under-45s.
prospects.why: Seasonal range news gives a hook for in-store festive displays aimed at younger shoppers.

prospects.headline: Full route revealed for 2027 Tour de France Femmes Grand Départ in Leeds
prospects.summary: Stage one starts on the Headrow on 30 July 2027 and loops through Headingley, Kirkstall, Bramley, Farnley and Drighlington before entering Kirklees. The council plans a letter drop to nearby properties, an online engagement session and an interactive route map.
prospects.why: A major event with resident and business communications, wayfinding and visitor materials to come in the next nine months.

prospects.headline: TransPennine Express introduces baby on board badges for pregnant customers
prospects.summary: The badges will be available from stations and carried by conductors across the network, letting expectant mothers signal they may need a seat. The scheme is aimed especially at customers whose pregnancy is not yet visible.
prospects.why: Passenger-facing scheme that will need on-train and station signage and awareness comms.

prospects.headline: Aldi installs Halloween broomstick parking bay at York store
prospects.summary: Aldi has put a pop-up broomstick parking bay, with a purpose-built rack, signage and floor vinyl, at its Water Lane store in York until 31 October. Taylor Herring delivered the stunt, which links to Aldi research in which 28% of 2,000 people named York Britain's most haunted place.
prospects.why: Shows Aldi will use playful store-level installations for seasonal moments, which sits in POS agency territory.

prospects.headline: Aldi launches 'Grounded in Goodness' sustainable beef scheme with ABP
prospects.summary: Aldi and ABP will pay premiums above market prices, plus technical support, to about 1,000 beef farmers in England, Scotland and Wales who commit to practices on soil health, biodiversity and animal welfare. Farmer selection starts in October 2026 and the first cohort should be onboard by spring 2027.
prospects.why: A named British beef provenance programme could feed future meat-aisle and shelf messaging, though in-store activity is not mentioned yet.

prospects.headline: M&S cuts prices on selected British beef, lamb and pork lines by up to 26%
prospects.summary: Diced beef falls from £7.00 to £6.00 and pork sausages from £2.60 to £2.00 under the Remarksable Value range. M&S is funding the cuts itself and says it wants shoppers to do more of their weekly shop there.
prospects.why: Price-led repositioning of fresh meat needs in-store price communication.

prospects.headline: Coca-Cola opens public vote on where its Christmas truck will visit
prospects.summary: Coca-Cola is letting people vote online for the next town to host its Christmas Truck, with voting open until 3 November. The truck offers samples, festive games and merchandise at each stop.
prospects.why: Large experiential programme for Christmas, a potential route into supporting retail and event activation.

prospects.headline: Caffè Nero launches Christmas menu nationwide on 4 November
prospects.summary: The menu includes a Praline Flat White, Salted Caramel & Orange Hot Chocolate and a Billionaires Snowflake dessert, with app loyalty members getting early access from 29 October. It forms part of the 'Pause for Joy' campaign.
prospects.why: A named seasonal campaign with app early access suggests in-store festive communication needs.

prospects.headline: Morrisons launches 'Market Street Monsters' Halloween out-of-home campaign
prospects.summary: Morrisons is running an out-of-home Halloween campaign until 31 October that uses edited photos to turn produce such as avocados, carrots and red peppers into monsters, set against its green backdrop with yellow price labels. Leo UK created the work and Zenith UK is handling media buying.
prospects.why: Produce-led seasonal creative built on price-label cues could translate to in-store POS; it also shows which agencies currently hold the account.

prospects.headline: Costa opens drive-thru at Waterloo Park in Waterlooville
prospects.summary: Costa opened a drive-thru at Waterloo Park, Waterlooville, on 22 October, creating up to 16 jobs. KFC and Aldi are due to open on the same Hargreaves-developed scheme on 26 October and 26 November.
prospects.why: Costa is still opening drive-thru sites, each needing exterior signage and menu boards.

prospects.headline: B&M opens refurbished store in former Poundland unit at Oaks Shopping Centre, Acton
prospects.summary: The 8,626 sq ft store opened on 24 October and has self-checkout tills and an upgraded frozen food section. It creates 50 jobs.
prospects.why: Store openings in converted units show a continuing roll-out that needs launch and in-store brand activity.

prospects.headline: CCEP launches Sprite on-pack NBA promotion with in-store activation
prospects.summary: Limited-edition Sprite packs with an NBA prize draw run from November 2026 to March 2027, supported by in-store activations, digital and creator marketing.
prospects.why: Multi-month on-pack promotion with in-store activation points to POS needs across grocery and convenience.

prospects.headline: KFC franchisee Adil Group opens York drive-thru in one of first sites of new design
prospects.summary: Adil Group opened a 64-seat drive-thru at Monks Cross, York, with four ordering kiosks and 40 jobs. It is among the first UK sites built to KFC's latest design, and part of a plan for 500 new restaurants over the next decade.
prospects.why: A new restaurant design and a large opening programme point to ongoing demand for site-level signage and POS.

prospects.headline: Black Sheep Coffee opens Glasgow city centre store with more Scottish sites planned
prospects.summary: A franchise store at 90-92 Gordon Street opened on 27 October with a £1 coffee offer. Franchisee SUR Group plans further openings in Glasgow Fort, Clydebank and Stirling in the coming months.
prospects.why: A franchise-led rollout of new stores creates repeatable opening and launch comms needs.

prospects.headline: Lidl GB to fund 1,500 £100 gift cards for teachers in primary school food programme
prospects.summary: The Lidl Foodies programme extends to children aged 8 to 11, with free lesson plans and a new website. Lidl aims to reach 35% of British primary schools by July 2027.
prospects.why: Community programme only; limited direct POS opening but shows Lidl's brand and schools engagement focus.

prospects.headline: B&M reportedly interested in buying some Poundland stores as sale process continues
prospects.summary: B&M is reported to want a group of stores rather than the whole chain, alongside other suitors including Lidl and The Range owner Chris Dawson. Poundland has nearly 600 stores and its owner wants a deal before Christmas.
prospects.why: Any store transfers would trigger refit and rebrand work for acquirers.

prospects.headline: Haribo UK sponsors Martin House hospice ball that raises over £280,000
prospects.summary: Haribo UK was headline sponsor of the Glitter Ball in Harrogate, which raised a record sum for Martin House Children's Hospice. The partnership spans more than 18 years.
prospects.why: Yorkshire-based CSR context only; useful for relationship-building rather than a pitch.

prospects.headline: Sheffield announces free Christmas celebration at Devonshire Green on 15 November
prospects.summary: The ticketed event includes tribute acts, local food and drink and a laser and light show. It is part of the city's festive opening weekend, with Christmas markets from 12 November and an ice rink to follow.
prospects.why: Seasonal city-centre campaign with event and wayfinding collateral, though the delivery window is very short.

prospects.headline: Newcastle warns of 10-day full Tyne Bridge closure from 23 October
prospects.summary: The bridge closes to all traffic until 2 November while a protection deck is built, with Metro buses replacing trains between St James and Monkseaton. The council is directing people to travel advice at tynebridge.org and park and ride sites.
prospects.why: Ongoing multi-phase works, with more overnight closures expected in November, mean continuing public information and signage needs.

prospects.headline: Nexus takes final Class 555 Metro train, completing 46-train fleet
prospects.summary: Stadler handed over the last train about two months ahead of the end-2026 target, completing the £362m programme. The last original Metro units left service in June 2026.
prospects.why: Fleet completion may prompt passenger-facing campaigns around the new service, though none is announced.

prospects.headline: West Yorkshire Combined Authority names interim chief executive
prospects.summary: Mike Palin is due to start on 2 November, subject to approval on 29 October, for about six months. Recruitment for a permanent chief executive begins in the coming weeks.
prospects.why: Leadership change could affect priorities and supplier decisions.

prospects.headline: Co-op and Devon and Cornwall Police reporting system solves almost 60% of shop thefts
prospects.summary: The SentrySIS platform, which lets Co-op staff upload incident details and CCTV for police, has reached a solve rate of almost 60% for shop theft, which the article says is approaching double the force's usual rate. It now covers all Co-op stores in Devon and Cornwall, and talks are under way with other forces.
prospects.why: Retail crime remains a live issue for Co-op; store-environment and signage work around security is a possible, if secondary, angle.

prospects.headline: Iceland benefit checks find £17m a year unclaimed by older shoppers
prospects.summary: Iceland's Benefits Boost campaign, funded with £1.8m from the Rothesay Foundation, has carried out over 4,100 free checks for customers aged 66 and over, identifying about £17m a year in unclaimed benefits, with more than £4.2m already secured. It could reach over 7,500 customers and more than £37m.
prospects.why: A community campaign aimed at older shoppers; in-store materials are possible, but this is mainly context.

prospects.headline: Work begins on £18m Dewsbury Market redevelopment
prospects.summary: Construction began on the market redevelopment, with a new town park and events space. A temporary market is open nearby and completion is expected in early 2028.
prospects.why: Long-running regeneration with trader and shopper comms, hoarding and wayfinding needs.

prospects.headline: German Doner Kebab opens restaurant at Rushden Lakes
prospects.summary: GDK opened its first Rushden Lakes site on 19 October, part of its expansion into high-footfall retail and leisure destinations.
prospects.why: Continued roll-out of new sites in retail parks; an opening-support opportunity, though minor.

prospects.headline: West Yorkshire Park and Ride adds late Light Night Leeds services with free child travel
prospects.summary: Extra evening services run on 28 and 29 October, with up to three under-19s travelling free per paying adult. Two Light Night installations are sited at Elland Road and Stourton Park and Ride.
prospects.why: Seasonal passenger comms through the combined authority's event travel promotions.

prospects.headline: Co-op and Circana sign multi-year deal to extend HIVE data partnership
prospects.summary: Co-op has renewed its partnership with Circana on HIVE, the data platform launched in 2020 that Co-op and its suppliers use to share sales, shopper and loyalty data. Supply chain, quick-commerce and wholesale insights will be added over the next five years.
prospects.why: Shared category data with suppliers can underpin joint shopper-marketing work; useful context rather than a direct POS brief.

prospects.headline: CMA designates Aldi and Lidl as large grocers, restricting land deals
prospects.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority has designated Aldi, Lidl GB and Lidl Northern Ireland as 'Large Grocery Retailers', so new land agreements cannot include covenants that stop rivals opening nearby. The CMA can also review existing agreements on request, citing the discounters' growing store estates.
prospects.why: Context on the scale of Lidl's estate growth; no direct POS brief.

prospects.headline: Booths to stock Perelló's new Spanish cupboard range in northern stores
prospects.summary: Brindisa-owned Perelló is launching five store-cupboard lines, including chopped tomatoes, tomate frito and sofrito, with listings at Ocado and at Booths stores in the North of England. Selected products arrive in November.
prospects.why: Minor signal that Booths continues to add specialist premium ranges.

prospects.headline: M&S commits to holding school uniform prices for 2027, extending freeze to seventh year
prospects.summary: M&S will not raise school uniform prices in 2027 and has introduced more durable fabrics and finishes. Some value lines have moved to two-packs, cutting cost per item by £2.
prospects.why: Seasonal clothing campaign angle that may need in-store messaging.

prospects.headline: North Yorkshire opens consultation on first county-wide local plan
prospects.summary: The six-week scoping consultation closes on 7 December 2026 and is the first of three formal opportunities to comment. Adoption is hoped for by the end of 2029.
prospects.why: Public consultation needing awareness and engagement materials.
